<TR>
<TD WIDTH="9%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B><A NAME="tx171340_1"></A>ITEM&nbsp;1.01.</B></FONT></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>ENTRY INTO A MATERIAL DEFINITIVE AGREEMENT. </B></FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">On March&nbsp;31, 2011, General Motors Holdings LLC (&#147;GM Holdings&#148;), a wholly-owned direct subsidiary of General Motors Company (&#147;GM&#148;), entered into an agreement with Delphi Automotive
LLP (&#147;Delphi&#148;) to sell 1,750,000 Class&nbsp;A Membership Interests in Delphi (the &#147;Transferred Membership Interests&#148;) back to Delphi for $3,791,400,000 in cash (the &#147;Transaction&#148;). The closing of the Transaction also
occurred on March&nbsp;31, 2011. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The Transferred Membership Interests represented 100% of GM&#146;s direct or indirect equity
interests in Delphi and 100% of Delphi&#146;s Class&nbsp;A Membership Interests issued and outstanding. The Transaction also terminated any direct or indirect obligation of GM to loan Delphi up to $500 million under a term loan facility established
in October 2009 when Delphi was created and the Transferred Membership Interests were issued. Delphi had not borrowed under this loan facility. A press release announcing the sale of the Transferred Membership Interests is filed herewith as Exhibit
99.1 and is incorporated by reference herein. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">GM expects to record a gain of approximately $1.6 billion in the first quarter
of 2011. The proceeds will improve GM&#146;s liquidity and be used for general corporate purposes. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="font-size:18px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<HTML><HEAD>
<TITLE>Press Release</TITLE>

 <BODY BGCOLOR="WHITE">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="right"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Exhibit 99.1 </B></FONT></P>
 <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center">

<IMG SRC="g171340img001.jpg" ALT="LOGO"> </P>
 <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>For Release: March&nbsp;31, 2011 </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>GM Announces Sale of its Stake in </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Delphi Automotive for $3.8 Billion
</B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">DETROIT &#150; General Motors Company (NYSE: GM) today announced the sale of its Class&nbsp;A Membership Interest in Delphi Automotive
LLP (Delphi) back to Delphi for $3.8&nbsp;billion. GM&nbsp;acquired the Class&nbsp;A Membership Interest in October 2009 in conjunction with the creation of&nbsp;Delphi. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&#147;We are systematically delivering on our commitment to strengthen and simplify our balance sheet,&#148; said Dan Ammann, GM senior vice president and chief financial officer as of April&nbsp;1.
</FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">GM will report a book gain of approximately $1.6&nbsp;billion in the first quarter of 2011 related to the sale. Earlier this month, GM sold
its Ally Financial Series A preferred stock for $1.0 billion in a registered public offering. The Ally transaction will result in a book gain of $0.3 billion to be recorded in the first quarter of 2011. </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>About General Motors &#150; </B>General Motors, one of the world&#146;s largest automakers, traces its roots back to 1908. With its global
headquarters in Detroit, GM employs 202,000 people in every major region of the world and does business in more than 120 countries. GM and its strategic partners produce cars and trucks in 30 countries, and sell and service these vehicles through
the following brands: Baojun, Buick, Cadillac, Chevrolet, GMC, Daewoo, Holden, Isuzu, Jiefang, Opel, Vauxhall, and Wuling. GM&#146;s largest national market is China, followed by the United States, Brazil, the United Kingdom, Germany, Canada, and
Italy. GM&#146;s OnStar subsidiary is the industry leader in vehicle safety, security and information services. More information on the new General Motors can be found at <U>www.gm.com</U>. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT
STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>CONTACT(S): </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>
